vulnerabilities.description: XSS through unescaped avatarUrl in HTML attribute. avatarHtml() constructs without escaping avatarUrl, allowing onerror= event injection if config comes from user input.
vulnerabilities.fix: Use textContent or createElement instead of innerHTML. For img src, validate URL format and encode attribute: src="" + encodeURI(url) + ""

vulnerabilities.description: XSS via innerHTML with potentially untrusted avatarHtml(). If config object is modified by attacker (via config fetch), this executes arbitrary HTML.
vulnerabilities.fix: Use textContent for text content. For HTML, use createElement/appendChild. Validate all config values against strict whitelist (hex colors, emoji codepoints).

vulnerabilities.description: CORS misconfiguration: allows requests with missing Origin header (same-origin, curl, server-to-server) with credentials=true. Attacker on same network can send credentials with arbitrary Host header.
vulnerabilities.fix: Require explicit Origin header for credentialed requests: if (!origin) return cb(new Error('Origin required')); OR use origin===FRONT_URL check only (no fallback for missing origin).

vulnerabilities.description: Potential SSRF vulnerability. orderStatusUrl from agent config is used directly in safeFetch without validation. If URL is user-controlled or injectable, attacker can scan internal network/cloud metadata endpoints.
vulnerabilities.fix: Validate orderStatusUrl: (1) whitelist protocol (https only), (2) reject localhost/127.0.0.1/private IPs, (3) reject cloud metadata IPs (169.254.169.254, etc), (4) DNS rebinding check if critical.

vulnerabilities.description: Avatar base64 fallback in DB without size limit check. resolveAvatarFields() stores base64 data URL (up to ~1-2MB per image) in widgetAvatarBase64 field if upload fails. Multiple uploads can cause storage exhaustion.
vulnerabilities.fix: Add size check: reject base64 >200KB. Force upload retry on failure instead of persisting fallback, or add quota per agent on base64 storage.

vulnerabilities.description: Decrypted tokens held in memory during tool execution. decryptToken() result passed to integration functions (gmail, slack, jira). If process crashes/dumps, token exposure risk.
vulnerabilities.fix: Clear token from memory after use. Consider using oauth2 token endpoint (refresh) instead of storing/decrypting long-lived tokens. Use memset-style clearing (overwrite buffer) if possible.

vulnerabilities.description: Conversation summary includes last N messages and lead contact info (name, email, phone) which may contain sensitive user data. If Slack channel is compromised or logs are exposed, PII leaks.
vulnerabilities.fix: Redact sensitive fields in summary: mask email (user****@domain), mask phone (***-**-1234), truncate message content. Add opt-out or data classification field.

vulnerabilities.description: DATABASE_URL must be defined in environment (via assertAuthSecrets check in index.ts). Risk: if env loading fails silently, default/fallback DB could be used. Verify error handling.
vulnerabilities.fix: Ensure assertAuthSecrets() is called BEFORE any DB operation. Add explicit throw if DATABASE_URL is missing, not just a warning.

vulnerabilities.description: Function `renderText` uses innerHTML after escaping but regex replacements happen on escaped text. Safe in context but innerHTML is generally risky pattern.
vulnerabilities.fix: Replace with textContent + createElement for safety: createElement('div'), set textContent, then replace with DOM nodes for bold/br elements.

vulnerabilities.description: Password validation too weak (minimum 6 characters). No complexity check (uppercase, numbers, special chars). Vulnerable to brute force attacks.
vulnerabilities.fix: Enforce minimum 12 characters + complexity requirements (uppercase, number, special char). Use zxcvbn library for strength estimation.

recommendations: URGENT: Fix XSS in widget.js (lines 55, 71) - switch from innerHTML to safe DOM methods
URGENT: Fix CORS origin check (line 85) - require explicit Origin header for credentialed requests
HIGH: Validate orderStatusUrl against SSRF patterns (whitelist protocol, reject private IPs)
HIGH: Add size limits and quotas for avatar base64 fallback storage
MEDIUM: Implement token memory clearing after integration tool execution
MEDIUM: Redact PII from conversation summaries sent to Slack/logs
MEDIUM: Verify assertAuthSecrets() runs before any DB access, with explicit error on missing vars
Review and test OAuth token refresh flow to reduce duration of decrypted keys in memory
Add security headers: CSP (Content-Security-Policy) to widget iframe/embed context
Audit all third-party dependencies for known CVEs (npm audit, snyk)
Add logging/alerting for authentication failures, token decryption errors, SSRF attempts
